about: The rules this site is checked against in CI (npm run check, tests/e2e/checks.spec.ts), in the words of the course's 'Check my page' checker: src/checks/checks.ts is a copy of it.

Every page listed under pages gets the groups in everyPage, then its own groups. Each group runs in a fresh page, at 1100 px and again at 390 px. A group passes when all its steps pass; when one fails, its fix says what to change.

A step is one of: {selector, count}, {selector, text}, {selector, textIncludes}, {selector, style}, {selector, loaded: true}, {click}, {type: [selector, text]}, {select: [selector, value]}, {width: 390 or 1100}. Selectors are CSS selectors.
{test-clinic} in a path is the clinic the checks make for themselves (tests/e2e/fixture.ts): a new site has no clinic until you add one.
When you add a page or a form, add it here too.
criteria: The page has one main heading (h1), and no heading level is skipped.
The page has its landmarks: a header with the menu, the main content, and a footer.
Every form field has a label.
The booking form shows the notice that this is a practice project: users give made-up details.

everyPage.fix: Give the page exactly one h1, its main heading, and do not skip a level: an h3 needs an h2 above it, an h4 an h3.
Keep the page's landmarks, as the site layout has them: one <header> with the menu in a <nav>, one <main>, and one <footer>.
Give every an alt text that says what the image shows, or alt="" for a picture that is only decoration.

groups.fix: Give every form field a visible <label> whose for= matches the field's id, or put the field inside its <label>.
